subject: Pricing bands, invoice routing, and PO interoperability
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@novacare.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@novacare.com
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO fields, wiring instructions, and pricing bands (Novacare)

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency numbers. Procurement has a couple of firm constraints before they can accept Redwood on our vendor list:

- We require a PO to reference a single contract_line_id per invoice (no multi-contract lines on one invoice).
- Net terms: our default is Net 60, but finance asks whether Net 30 for the first two quarters is negotiable if we can agree discounts on committed usage bands.
- Invoice delivery: AP only ingests invoices via SFTP weekly on Fridays; they will not process daily arrival.
- PO format: our ERP needs a vendor_tax_id field and a PO acknowledgement number returned in the 850/810 mapping.

I attached our procurement PO template to show the required fields. Is Redwood able to: (a) emit invoices that map to a single contract_line_id when multiple contracts are in a monthly commitment, and (b) provide a weekly consolidated CSV for the Friday ingest?

If you can confirm the PO and invoice workflow we can move to legal/finance for signature. Also copied AP so they see the format expectations.

Appreciate it,

Laura Chen
Sr. Procurement Manager
Novacare
Attachment: Novacare_PO_template.pdf

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@novacare.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO fields, wiring instructions, and pricing bands (Novacare)

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear note and for the template. Short answers up front: yes on weekly consolidated CSVs and yes on returning an acknowledgement number. A couple of details to confirm about the contract_line_id requirement so we can recommend an operational approach:

1) "Single contract_line_id per invoice" — do you mean that each invoice file must contain charges only for one contract_line_id, or that the invoice metadata must have a single primary contract_line_id even if line items span multiple contracts?

2) If Novacare wants Net 30 for the first two quarters in exchange for an additional committed usage discount, can you share the target discount band (e.g., additional 5% at >$250k/quarter, 8% at >$500k)? That will help our pricing team map a banded SKU.

Operationally we propose two options:
- Option A (preferred): We produce a weekly consolidated invoice file that contains a separate invoice per contract_line_id and a wrapper summary CSV for your SFTP ingestion. That meets the single-contract-line requirement by keeping one invoice per contract_line_id, no mixing.
- Option B: We put a primary_contract_line_id field in the invoice envelope and include multiple line items; Redwood would mark which lines are billable to which contract. This option needs an ERP mapping on your side to parse sub-lines.

I've cc'd Ben (sales) and Priya (finance/ops) to weigh in on discount bands and billing adjustments. I'll attach a billing matrix draft that shows how we can break invoices by contract and still provide a single weekly CSV for Friday ingestion.

Best,
Sofia
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_Billing_Matrix.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO fields, wiring instructions, and pricing bands (Novacare)

Team — looping in Marcus on the pricing side. Notes from pricing/finance perspective and a suggested commercial structure we could offer to Novacare if they move to Net 30 for Q1+Q2:

- Baseline: Standard hosted list with 10% PLG engagement discount built in.
- Commitment bands (quarterly):
  - Band 1: $0 - $250k -> baseline price
  - Band 2: $250k - $500k -> 5% off baseline on incremental usage
  - Band 3: $500k+ -> 8% off baseline on incremental usage

- Net 30 concession: we can offer a one-time 2% invoice credit applied in the first settlement cycle if Novacare signs a 6-month committed minimum (we need an SOW addendum).
- Po interoperability: Option A (one invoice per contract_line_id) is operationally simpler for both sides and preferred. We'll need field-level mapping for vendor_tax_id and the PO acknowledgement header (we can populate the acknowledgement number when the invoice is generated).
- Weekly SFTP file: Redwood can produce a zipped CSV package for Friday delivery; format will include: invoice_id, contract_line_id, vendor_tax_id, acknowledgement_number, total_amount, currency, settlement_date.

Marcus, any constraints on offering a steeper band or accelerating credits?

Thanks,
Ben
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@novacare.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@novacare.com
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO fields, wiring instructions, and pricing bands (Novacare)

Hi all — quick follow-up and commitments from Redwood side.

Laura,

Thanks for the template and for the flexibility on terms. We can confirm the following operational commitments if Novacare agrees to Net 30 for the first two quarters and a 6-month minimum:

1) Invoices will be emitted as one invoice per contract_line_id. Each invoice file will contain the vendor_tax_id and an acknowledgement_number field returned in the top-level metadata.
2) Redwood will generate a weekly SFTP payload on Fridays (UTC-based delivery window) containing a zipped CSV with invoice rows and a small JSON manifest. If Novacare cannot process the manifest, we can also provide a flat CSV.
3) Pricing bands as Ben proposed (5% and 8% incremental discounts). We will also apply a one-time 2% credit within the first settlement run for the Net 30 concession, visible as a negative line item (credit) on the first series of invoices.

Next steps:
- Laura: confirm the exact discount trigger targets (if Novacare wants different $ thresholds).
- Novacare AP: confirm SFTP hostname, inbound folder path, and if they prefer zipped CSV + manifest or flat CSV.
- Contract: Redwood legal will prepare a short SOW addendum that references deal ND-2026-0911 and the billing/PO fields we agreed.

I'll attach a short summary of terms we can move to DocuSign after you confirm the SFTP details.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Director, Pricing & Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_Terms_Summary.pdf
